In this RK Nex Plus Two session, we discuss the latest information regarding the HSS Christmas Exam Timetable 2026, including examination dates, subject-wise schedules, important instructions, and preparation strategies for Kerala Higher Secondary Second Year students.

Whether you are studying Science, Commerce, or Humanities, understanding the examination schedule can help you organize your studies and prepare effectively.

🎯 Why Watch This Video?

The Plus Two Christmas Exam 2026 is an important examination for Kerala Higher Secondary Second Year students. Understanding the exam schedule helps students organize their revision, prioritize important chapters, and prepare confidently.

According to reports published on 12 November 2026, Kerala Higher Secondary Christmas Examinations are scheduled from 8 December to 17 December 2026. Schools will hold Christmas celebrations on 18 December and reopen on 28 December.
